text: {"grades": [{"area": "contact", "level": "ok_with_setting", "reason": "Strangers can message or voice chat with the child in multiplayer mode, but this can be turned off via settings.", "setting": "chat set to 'friends only' or turned off completely", "findings": ["f_6a1a0ef028865ef4", "f_8a83b3de676ad8b0"]}, {"area": "money", "level": "flag", "reason": "The app pushes in-app purchases through Minecoins, and children can complete purchases without parental approval, with reports of scams and unauthorized charges.", "setting": "", "findings": ["f_bbdd451071f6eabc", "f_4f0d24b3b6bb0948", "f_5adae5391d64ec0f", "f_197d5537975444c2", "f_52134516877ae723"]}, {"area": "data", "level": "ok_with_setting", "reason": "The app collects data for personalized ads and may share it with third parties, but child accounts provide guardrails and data deletion is possible.", "setting": "child accounts automatically provide guardrails against the collection of some data", "findings": ["f_62d7413616ee25d9", "f_7bff118ec684f6e0"]}, {"area": "age_gating", "level": "ok_with_setting", "reason": "The age gate requires linking a child account to a parent account for users under 16, which locks the account to the correct age band when properly set up.", "setting": "Players younger than 16 will automatically have a \"child account,\" which must be linked to an adult account.", "findings": ["f_ee415e54d7a54a34", "f_2ce338a674496b51"]}, {"area": "content", "level": "flag", "reason": "Parents report children encountering racist language in the game, which constitutes unsuitable material for a 9-year-old.", "setting": "", "findings": ["f_c9072b9921500c3f"]}, {"area": "developer_record", "level": "flag", "reason": "The developer has faced regulatory scrutiny and fines related to privacy practices, including illegal collection and retention of children's data.", "setting": "", "findings": ["f_de8b2f2e9b3dc91e", "f_67deee1afa40eb39", "f_796e7220c1a87086", "f_c5ec48a6801685f6"]}]}
